guides.title: 工程操作與定量驗證手冊
guides.concept: 以「自由基曝露、光能與副產物證據」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。
guides.conceptEn: Follow radical exposure, photon energy and by-product evidence through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.
procedure: 在「目標污染物與背景水質」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 200 mg/h，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只依目標物質量估氧化劑可能漏掉主要清除劑。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「擬一級降解模型」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.22313 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「彎曲衰減仍硬套單一常數會高估末段去除。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「所需反應時間」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 15.3506 min，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「把log10直接代入自然對數式會少算時間。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「自由基競爭分率」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.1 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「把總自由基產生量當成全部作用於目標會誇大去除。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「紫外光透射與光程」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.501187 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「以入口光強乘停留時間會忽略陰影與吸收。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「有效容積與停留時間」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 3 min，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「平均時間合理仍可能存在未充分處理的短路流。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「單位對數去除電耗」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 1 kWh/m3/order，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「把照明效率與全系統效率混同會低報耗能。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「殘餘氧化劑與淬熄」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 200 mg，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「未淬熄樣品會把瓶內持續反應誤當反應器效果。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「中間產物與碳收支」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.2 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「以99%母體去除宣稱99%礦化是不同指標混用。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「量測不確定度與放大」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.05 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只依容積比放大燈數會漏掉光程改變。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
procedureEn: In the teaching model or spreadsheet for target compound and matrix, first reproduce 200 mg/h, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Dosing from target mass alone misses dominant scavengers." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for pseudo-first-order decay, first reproduce 0.22313 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Forcing one constant onto curved decay can overpredict late removal." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for required reaction time, first reproduce 15.3506 min, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Substituting log10 into a natural-log expression underestimates time." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for competition for radicals, first reproduce 0.1 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Assigning all generated radicals to the target exaggerates removal." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for uv transmission and path length, first reproduce 0.501187 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Multiplying inlet intensity by residence time ignores shadowing and absorption." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for active volume and residence time, first reproduce 3 min, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "A plausible mean can coexist with under-treated bypass flow." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for electrical energy per order, first reproduce 1 kWh/m3/order, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Equating lamp efficiency with system efficiency understates energy." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for residual oxidant and quenching, first reproduce 200 mg, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "An unquenched sample misattributes bottle reaction to reactor performance." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for intermediates and carbon balance, first reproduce 0.2 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Claiming99% mineralization from99% parent removal conflates metrics." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for uncertainty and scale-up, first reproduce 0.05 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Scaling lamp count by volume alone misses changed optical paths." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.
evidence: 固定目標物濃度，改變背景DOC比較反應速率。
用半對數濃度圖檢查斜率是否近似固定。
比較90%與99%去除的時間並說明對數關係。
把背景清除速率減半並比較目標分率。
改變光程，量測入口與出口光強。
以脈衝示蹤比較早到峰與名目V/Q。
比較相同去除倍數下不同處理容積的EEO。
比較立即淬熄、延遲淬熄與空白樣品。
把母體去除率與TOC去除率畫在同一圖上。
比較不同光程試驗，記錄量測誤差和流動條件。
evidenceEn: Keep target concentration fixed and vary background DOC to compare reaction rate.
Check for a near-constant slope on a semilog concentration plot.
Compare times for90% and99% removal and explain the logarithmic relation.
Halve background scavenging and compare the target fraction.
Vary path length and measure entrance and exit intensity.
Compare an early tracer peak with nominal V/Q.
Compare EEO at equal removal ratio for different treated volumes.
Compare immediate quench, delayed quench and blanks.
Plot parent and TOC removal on the same chart.
Compare tests at different path lengths with measurement error and flow conditions recorded.
pitfalls: 只依目標物質量估氧化劑可能漏掉主要清除劑。
彎曲衰減仍硬套單一常數會高估末段去除。
把log10直接代入自然對數式會少算時間。
把總自由基產生量當成全部作用於目標會誇大去除。
以入口光強乘停留時間會忽略陰影與吸收。
平均時間合理仍可能存在未充分處理的短路流。
把照明效率與全系統效率混同會低報耗能。
未淬熄樣品會把瓶內持續反應誤當反應器效果。
以99%母體去除宣稱99%礦化是不同指標混用。
只依容積比放大燈數會漏掉光程改變。
pitfallsEn: Dosing from target mass alone misses dominant scavengers.
Forcing one constant onto curved decay can overpredict late removal.
Substituting log10 into a natural-log expression underestimates time.
Assigning all generated radicals to the target exaggerates removal.
Multiplying inlet intensity by residence time ignores shadowing and absorption.
A plausible mean can coexist with under-treated bypass flow.
Equating lamp efficiency with system efficiency understates energy.
An unquenched sample misattributes bottle reaction to reactor performance.
Claiming99% mineralization from99% parent removal conflates metrics.
Scaling lamp count by volume alone misses changed optical paths.

guides.scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

related.title: 新加坡新生水系統
related.why: 比較兩個系統的物質或能量收支，列出不可直接沿用的邊界條件。
related.whyEn: Compare material or energy balances and identify boundary conditions that cannot be transferred.
related.difference: 設備尺度、進料組成與品質目標必須分別設定。
related.differenceEn: Equipment scale, feed composition and quality objectives require separate definitions.
practice: 各選一個教學算例，記下輸入、輸出與單位。
對照兩課的系統邊界，說明哪些假設不能沿用。
改變一個輸入，提出量測與失效判據來核對結果。
practiceEn: Choose one worked example from each course and record inputs, outputs and units.
Compare system boundaries and identify assumptions that cannot transfer.
Change one input and propose measurements and failure criteria to check the result.

courses.summary: 本課以來源所列的技術指引與研究為閱讀脈絡，並非重建某一設施的工程沿革；算例、數據與場景參數皆為原創教學假設。比較舊方法與感測、控制、資源回收整合的方法時，先固定處理功能及系統邊界，再評估效率與可靠度。
courses.summaryEn: The cited technical guidance and research provide a reading pathway, not the engineering history of a particular facility. Examples, data and scene parameters are original teaching assumptions. When comparing conventional methods with integrated sensing, control and resource recovery, hold the treatment function and system boundary fixed before assessing efficiency and reliability.
